title: Reggie Leaks Cenat DMs: Streamer posts ‘cry for help’ messages; Fanum urges focus on mental health
summary_full: Reggie, also known as Lil Rodney Son, has shared private DMs with Kai Cenat after claiming he urgently needed his support. The messages show Reggie asking Cenat to answer his call and describing it as a “cry for help.” Reggie also shared a lengthy message from Fanum, who urged him to step away from online pressure and focus on his well-being. Agent 00 declined to discuss the controversy.
